# TASK
1. Analysis MetaGPT paper
2. Extract The framework and logic of MetaGPT
3. 设计project 框架,采用factory mode, use langgraph
4. design code category(including config.py, logger.py, prompts.py), and give me extreme detailed code file by file using different artifacts


# workflow
```
flowchart LR
    U[User\nOne-line requirement:\n"Write a classic and simple Flappy Bird game."]

    PM[MetaGPT Product Manager\nOutput: Requirement document]
    AR[MetaGPT Architect\nOutput: System design]
    PJ[MetaGPT Project Manager\nOutput: Task list]
    EN[MetaGPT Engineer\nOutput: Code]
    QA[MetaGPT QA Engineer\nOutput: Test report]
    BOSS[Boss / Human\nAcceptance check & payment]

    U -->|1/5 Define| PM
    PM -->|2/5 Design| AR
    AR -->|3/5 Plan| PJ
    PJ -->|3/5 Code| EN
    EN -->|4/5 Test| QA
    QA -->|5/5 Acceptance| BOSS
```

# Example
```
1. Shared Message Pool 侧（左半部分）

参与角色：
• Architect（带 diagram tool）
• Project Manager（带 diagram tool）
• Product Manager（带 web search tool）
• QA Engineer（带 web search tool，Python 图标表示可执行代码相关）

共享消息池示意：
• 消息列表：msgA / msgB / msgC / msgD
• 其中一条示例消息结构大致为：

content: {Architect: Implementation appro...}
instruct_content: "Data structures and in ..."
cause_by: WriteTasks
sent_from: ProjectManager
send_to: Engineer


• Engineer 通过 subscription（订阅）从 Shared Message Pool 里接收消息
• Engineer 处理后会通过 publish（发布）把结果写回 Shared Message Pool

底部工具栏：
• Tools:
• web search tool
• debugging tool
• diagram tool

⸻

2. Agent Profile & 编程循环（右半部分）

Agent Profile（示例 Agent）：
• Name: Alex
• Profile: Engineer
• Goal:
Write elegant, readable, extensible, efficient code
• Constraint:
The code you write should conform to code standard like PEP8,
be modular, easy to read and maintain

⸻

3. Engineer Agent 的内部工作流

总体：Iterative Programming（迭代编程） + Memory
• Engineer（Alex）接收来自 Shared Message Pool 的 Structured Message(…)
• 其内部有：
• Memory：用于存储经验/知识
• Memory Retrieval：从 Memory 中检索信息
• History Message：
• PRD Document
• System Design
• Code

迭代编程核心：
• 任务示例：Write game.py
• 代码框中示例片段（game.py）：

## Code: game.py
## game.py
import random

class Game:
    def __init__(self, self, size=4):
        self.size = size
        self.score = 0
        self.high_score = 0
        self.board = [[0]*size for _ in range(size)]
        self.game_over = False
        self.start()


• 代码执行流：
• Debug → Execution
• 如果执行失败：红叉（❌）→ 回到 Debug
• 如果执行成功：绿勾（✅）→ 产生 Executable Feedback

反馈与历史：
• 执行成功的代码与结果以 Executable Feedback 形式输出
• 通过 “Add Code” 写入 History Message（PRD/System Design/Code 等文档）
• 这些历史信息又可在后续迭代中被 Memory Retrieval 使用

⸻
```

The site is a **JavaScript SPA** — `#chaptercontent` is injected by JS after page load, so `aiohttp` (which doesn't execute JS) gets a bare shell. You need a headless browser. Here's the fix using **Playwright**:

```bash
pip install playwright
playwright install chromium
```
